verdicts.reason: A: the green circle sits alone at the far left, cut off from the phone it used to back. The phone and the tagline are pushed to the far right with a dead gap between them. The tagline is tiny. The SOLSTICE wordmark falls under the headline. The CTA is the same size as the badges in one cramped row, so it doesn't stand out.
